records.readable_german: Fuer ?KM. Abendmeldung. ?LPENZOR?S nordwestl. UJVID?K. 217I beim Donauuebergang bei S?ANKAMEN, ?JVIDEK.
records.title: Evening Danube report with unresolved unit and place labels
records.meaning: The proposed ordinary-word reading is an evening report: the label ?LPENZOR?S is northwest of UJVID?K, and the literal unit-like field 217I is at a Danube crossing near the place sequence S?ANKAMEN / ?JVIDEK. These opaque labels and the six unknown positions remain visible. The punctuation is editorial and does not establish a particular route or exact formation.
records.reading_note: Ten printed dashes remain ten coordinate slots. The primary proposal repairs only ABENDMELDUNG, NORDWESTL, BEIM and DONAUUEBERGANG through three observed-coordinate substitutions and four mask fills. It leaves the command, formation and geographical fields unresolved. In particular, 217I is not silently expanded or changed to a numbered division. The separate name proposal below costs one additional observed-coordinate substitution and five additional fills.

optional_name_candidate.readable_german: Fuer ?KM. Abendmeldung. Alpenkorps nordwestl. Ujvidek. 217I beim Donauuebergang bei Slankamen, Ujvidek.
optional_name_candidate.limit: A lexical and internal-repeat proposal only. The two Ujvidek forms are mutually compatible with the raw UJVID?K and ?JVIDEK, but these names are not supplied by an independent copy of this message. ?KM and the literal 217I remain unresolved/unexpanded.

records.title: German Embassy address and Auswaertig signature label
records.meaning: The first of two announced parts gives an address to the German Embassy in Constantinople and an Unterschrift field reading Auswaertig. The proposal repairs the final city-name letter only. The next part and any substantive message body are not supplied here.
records.reading_note: The native stream reads KONSTANTINOPEI. Changing source 116 V→A proposes KONSTANTINOPEL at a cost of one observed-coordinate substitution. All other words and the complete 120-slot frame remain unchanged. Auswaertig is not expanded by adding Amt.

records.readable_german: Deutsche Botschaft Pera. Nr. 1882. Fuer Monsignore Dolci. Unterschrift Stumm.
records.title: Pera embassy address for Monsignore Dolci, reference 1882
records.meaning: The surviving first part gives the German Embassy at Pera, reference 1882, for the person named Monsignore Dolci, with a Stumm signature field. Neither name is identified beyond the literal text. The reading does not supply a second part or infer its substantive instructions.
records.reading_note: The final glyph of the printed group FAFXJ at source 119 is J-like and outside the coordinate alphabet; that one position is masked. Filling it with V supplies the missing F in FUER. Three observed-coordinate substitutions separately repair BO1SCHAFT and UNTERSCHRIVT. The raw 1 inside BO1SCHAFT is not a numerical label silently relabeled: its change to T is paid for through actual source-coordinate substitutions. Reference1882 is untouched. The clear header time has an uncertain interior mark and is not normalized.
